# Store presentation browser vendor

Unmodified official PptxGenJS 4.0.1 `dist/pptxgen.bundle.js`, copied from the already configured primary runtime package. No CDN or new dependency install. The embedded ZIP implementation is JSZip 3.10.1; distribution uses its MIT license option.

Keep PptxGenJS.LICENSE, JSZip.LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt and RECEIPT.json with this asset. THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt preserves license texts for the ZIP dependency families (MIT, ISC and zlib notices); versions in the installed dependency tree are not asserted as a rebuild of the minified bundle.

Official sources: https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS and https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
